# Guest passes link shows as invalid despite 2 passes remaining

- State: closed
- Author: 001005HS
- Created: 2026-03-16T02:30:56Z
- Updated: 2026-04-26T14:29:15Z
- Repository: anthropics/claude-code
- Number: #34816

## Labels

- bug
- platform:linux
- area:cli
- stale

---

## Description

When using `/passes` command in Claude Code, it shows 2 guest passes remaining and generates a referral link (`https://claude.ai/referral/...`), but the link appears to be invalid/not working when shared.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `/passes` in Claude Code CLI
2. Dialog shows "Guest passes · 2 left"
3. Copy the generated referral link
4. Link does not work / shows as invalid

## Expected Behavior

The referral link should be valid and allow the recipient to redeem a free week of Claude Code.

## Environment

- Platform: Linux (Ubuntu)
- Claude Code CLI (latest)

## Timeline

- github-actions[bot] added label "bug"

- github-actions[bot] added label "platform:linux"

- github-actions[bot] added label "area:cli"

> A few things to check that might help narrow this down:
> 
> **1. Link format**
> 
> Can you confirm the exact URL format you're getting? It should look like:
> ```
> https://claude.ai/referral/ 
> ```
> If it's a different format or has extra characters (trailing whitespace, newline, etc.), that could cause it to show as invalid.
> 
> **2. Link expiration**
> 
> Guest pass links have a time limit. If there's a delay between generating the link with `/passes` and sharing it, the link may have expired. Try generating a fresh link and sharing it immediately.
> 
> **3. Recipient eligibility**
> 
> Guest passes are for new users who don't already have a Claude account. If the person you're sharing with already has a claude.ai account (even a free one), the link may show as invalid for them. Have them try opening it in an incognito/private browser window to rule out existing session cookies interfering.
> 
> **4. Region restrictions**
> 
> Some referral programs have geographic restrictions. If the recipient is in a region where Claude isn't fully available, the link could appear invalid.
> 
> **5. CLI version**
> 
> You mentioned "latest" — can you confirm the exact version? (`claude --version`) There have been cases where the `/passes` command generates links against a different environment. Updating to the absolute latest (`npm update -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`) might help if you're on a slightly older build.
> 
> **6. Reproduction test**
> 
> Try opening the link yourself in an incognito window (where you're not logged into Claude). Does it show as invalid there too, or does it show a signup/redeem page? That would help distinguish between a link generation issue vs. a recipient-side issue.
> 
> If you can share the error message the recipient sees (screenshot or exact text), that would help the team diagnose whether this is a link generation bug or a redemption/eligibility issue.

**yurukusa** commented on 2026-03-16T04:19:13Z:

> Thanks for the details. Version 2.1.76 is current, so that's not the issue.
> 
> **On the consumed pass:**
> 
> This sounds like a known behavior — when you press Enter on the `/passes` screen to copy the link, some users have reported it counts as "claimed" even if the link was never actually opened by another person. The link URL (`/referral/18tu0-9FlA`) is generated and marked as issued at copy time, not at redemption time.
> 
> If the link then shows as "expired" when your friend opens it, there are two likely scenarios:
> 
> 1. **Time-to-live expired** — Guest pass links have a limited validity window (typically hours, not days). If you copied the link and sent it later, it may have expired before your friend clicked it.
> 2. **Single-use consumed at generation** — The pass may have been consumed when it was generated/copied. This would be a bug (pass should be consumed at redemption, not generation).
> 
> **What to try:**
> 
> - Generate a fresh pass with `/passes` right now, copy the link, and have your friend open it **immediately** (within minutes, not hours)
> - Have your friend open it in an **incognito/private window** to avoid any session interference
> - If this second pass also shows expired immediately, that points to a bug in the pass generation system rather than a timing issue
> 
> **On tracking who used it:**
> 
> Unfortunately, there's no way for you to see who redeemed a guest pass. Anthropic's team would need to check server-side logs. If you believe the pass was consumed without your knowledge, that's worth flagging to Anthropic support directly (support.anthropic.com) since it could indicate a security issue with the referral link system.
